t: Set consisting of essential connectors and 2-setting hose nozzle. Suitable for use with most hose pipes and outdoor taps. Easy twist function operation. Universal fitting with UV resistance.
b: Contents: 2-Setting Hose Nozzle, 2-in-1 ½"/5/8" Hose End Connector, 2-in-1 ½"/5/8" Aqua Stop Hose End Connector & ½"-1" Tap Adaptor
